approval: Owner 10/22 (#133 audit part 2, §7 table, item 1 '同意')
purpose: Pre-registered definition of what counts as a correct forward judgment, frozen before the first outcome matures (promoted group 20-session on 2026-10-27, fo-1.0 on 2026-11-05). Changing any field under 'rules' requires a new contract_id approved by the Owner; outcomes always record the contract_hash they were scored under.

rules.primary_metric: excess_vs_qqq = (close_h / close_0 - 1) - (QQQ_h / QQQ_0 - 1), closes taken only from the ledgers' own rows
rules.unmapped_decision: unscored_unmapped (counted, never a hit or miss)
rules.missing_close: unavailable (counted separately, never scored, never filled)
rules.below_min_n: report 'insufficient_sample' with n; no hit rate, no interval
rules.independence_view: also report independent episodes: only the first row of each run of consecutive sessions with the same (symbol, decision) counts
descriptive_only: max adverse excursion over the window from the ledger's daily closes
